# Final Review Proposal
**Producer:** agent:claude/claude-opus-4-7-max

## Summary

Round 3 final review of frozenkrill-ugd. All acceptance criteria met: cargo build/test/clippy/fmt clean; 69 secret_sharing unit tests + 5 integration tests pass; net reduction 187 lines in secret_sharing.rs (target ≥180). The two structural simplifications landed correctly: (1) internal `Share` struct collapsed — `split_mnemonic` now builds `VssJsonWalletDescriptionV0` directly with `original_wallet: SinglesigPublicMetadataV0::default()`, and `combine_shares_to_mnemonic`/`combine_vss_wallets` consume the public type without synthetic clones; (2) `SuccessEntry` simplified to `(SecretBox<Mnemonic>, Vec<VssJsonWalletDescriptionV0>)` with `derive_metadata` reading verifiers off `verified_inputs` directly. All cryptographic semantics preserved: Pedersen blind-commitment verification, M-of-N Shamir reconstruction, fail-closed authentication, candidate cross-product enumeration, per-share verifier-corruption tolerance, on-disk JSON layout. The strict-majority denominator change (`total_vote_ids = by_id.len()` before conflict filtering) actually strengthens the duress fail-closed property: conflicting duplicate copies can no longer shrink their way into a fabricated `is_duress=true` majority — covered by the new `test_duplicate_metadata_conflicts_count_against_duress_majority` and `test_spliced_lo_hi_share_does_not_vote_on_metadata` tests, plus the `complete_verified_inputs` filter that drops lo/hi-spliced shares with mismatched cryptographic identifiers from metadata voting. All round 1 and round 2 amendments are addressed (denominator vulnerability fixed, dead `verification_data` rewrite removed, line target met). No new findings; bead has converged.

## Amendments

None.
